---
title: "P.O.R.E.: Programmable Nanopore Fabrication"
subtitle: "Instrumentation and experimental automation"
---

**P.O.R.E. — Programmable Ohmic Research Engine** is a programmable platform for low-cost solid-state nanopore fabrication.

## Research question

How can electrical control and experimental instrumentation be integrated into repeatable nanopore-fabrication workflows?

## Contributions

I contributed to the platform’s development by supporting integration of electrical control, experimental instrumentation, and device-fabrication workflows. I also participated in platform characterization and experimental validation, and contributed to the publication describing the system.

## Publication

[Gu et al., IEEE Access (2026)](https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3727354) describes the platform and its validation.
